Description: Chladni-style standing-wave modes combine into evolving acoustic sand patterns, with nodal lines and resonant surface motion.
KScript: var half := max(v0,1.0); var qx := pi*x/half; var qy := pi*y/half; var mode_a := sin(qx*v1)*sin(qy*v2); var mode_b := sin(qx*v3)*sin(qy*v4); var field := mode_a-mode_b*v5; var pulse := sin(t*v6+u*v7); var height := field*pulse*v8; z += height; sx := sx*(1.0+abs(field)*v9); sy := sy*(1.0+abs(field)*v9); sz := sz*(1.0+abs(field)*v9); rx += cos(qx*v1)*sin(qy*v2)*v10; ry += sin(qx*v1)*cos(qy*v2)*v10;
